Binance reviews the 7702 authorization attack｜Why withdrawals being paused still requires on-chain revocation｜I’ll wait before ETH reaches $2,168

My priority is to manage risk first, then consider a rebound. On November 9, Binance’s official news account published a management security discussion that provided further details about the October 29 security incident: attackers first lured an engineer into running malicious code through a fake job interview, then gained access to relevant systems and set up an EIP-7702 delegated authorization in a hot wallet. This involved an attack on exchange wallets, personnel, and deployment processes—not a breach of Ethereum mainnet consensus, nor a new theft that happened today.

One detail traders should remember is that “pausing withdrawals” and “revoking on-chain authorization” are two separate actions. Binance’s preliminary report on November 3 stated that after the attackers set up the delegation, the authorization already submitted on-chain could still take effect independently even if the exchange paused normal withdrawals; Binance needed to send a separate transaction to revoke it. The report records that the final unauthorized transfer, of 2,961.9 ETH, was completed at 23:56 UTC on October 29, followed by an authorization transaction to clear the delegation code at 00:10 UTC on October 30. Binance said it had observed no further unauthorized transfers since then and disclosed that it had intercepted 57 suspected North Korea-linked cyber threats this year. The 57 cases are Binance’s own interception figures; they should not be described as 57 incidents that resulted in losses.

The impact on ETH is not simply “it was stolen, so the price must fall.” In the short term, the main channels are trust in exchange custody, withdrawal arrangements, market-maker funding flows, and risk appetite. In the longer term, the incident is a reminder to all institutions using smart account authorizations to include revoking authorizations alongside suspending internal services in their emergency response plans. It does not directly change ETH’s issuance, nor does it prove that applications across the network share the same configuration issue. ETH is still among the trending topics on Square after six hours, but none of this round’s trending topics directly matches this security review with an accurate label, so I won’t force an unrelated trend to fit.

ETHUSDT on Binance was trading at around $2,129, down about 0.31% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,168.35 and a low of $2,083.10. The market is still moving within this range, and this discussion cannot be treated as the sole cause of price movements. Around $2,168 is the confirmation level to the upside, while around $2,083 is the downside risk level; if price cannot even hold above the former, there is little price evidence to support the claim that the risk has been absorbed.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now. I’d only consider a small spot long if the conditions are met, with a maximum position size of 6% of tradable capital. The entry trigger is a four-hour close above $2,168, followed by a pullback that holds above $2,150; if there is no pullback, I won’t chase. After the trigger, the first target is $2,240, where I’d halve the position; the next target is $2,300, where I’d halve it again. I’d close the remaining position if a four-hour candle closes back below $2,168. The initial stop-loss is $2,105; if hit, I’d exit the entire position. No leverage and no adding to the position. If price first breaks below $2,083, the plan is canceled; if there is further official disclosure of a new uncontrolled transfer, I’d immediately discard the view that risks are easing and stop opening positions. This is a conditional plan that has not been triggered and does not mean a trade has already been executed.

Sources: Binance News discussion on November 9, Binance preliminary report on November 3, Binance ETHUSDT market data. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

币安复盘7702授权攻击｜暂停提币仍需链上撤销｜ETH在2168美元前我先等

我的态度是先防风险，再谈反弹。币安新闻官方账号11月9日刊出管理层安全对谈，补充解释10月29日安全事件：攻击者先用假招聘面试诱导工程师运行恶意代码，随后取得相关系统权限，并在热钱包建立EIP-7702委托授权。这里讨论的是交易所钱包与人员、部署流程遭攻击，不是以太坊主网共识被攻破，也不是今天发生的新盗币。

值得交易者记住的细节，是“暂停提现”和“撤销链上授权”属于两套动作。币安11月3日的初步报告写明，攻击者建立委托后，即使交易所暂停正常提现，已提交到链上的授权仍可独立起作用；币安需要另发交易撤销。报告记录最后一笔2961.9枚ETH未经授权转移在10月29日23:56 UTC完成，随后10月30日00:10 UTC发出清除委托代码的授权交易。币安称此后未再观察到未经授权的转移，并披露今年拦截57起疑似朝鲜关联网络威胁。57起是币安自己的拦截统计，不能写成57起已经造成损失。

这件事对ETH的影响不是简单的“被盗所以币价必跌”。短期主要传导在交易所托管信任、提现安排、做市资金周转和风险偏好；长期则提醒所有使用智能账户授权的机构，把撤销授权与暂停内部服务同时纳入应急预案。它不直接改变ETH发行量，也不证明全网应用都存在同一配置问题。广场六小时热搜仍有ETH，但本轮热门话题没有与这次安全复盘直接对应的准确标签，我不拿别的热点硬套。

A katana instead of probation.
How the Ethereum Foundation wrote “harakiri” into its corporate mandate and explained that it was art

The Ethereum Foundation drafted a “Mandate” for 1,000 years. Not for a five-year plan, but for a millennium. Among its 38 pages is a clause called the “Source Seppuku License”: break your promise, and you’re expected to take your own life with a sword. Contracts usually threaten you with fines; this one goes straight to the katana.

Employees timidly asked, “Could we maybe remove it?” According to them, 79 people voted to delete it, and 53 signed a letter. The clause remained, and the document was recorded on the blockchain. Now Ctrl+Z will never work.

The Foundation explained that it was “not literal,” just part of the artistic design. The sword was presumably drawn, but the questions are real.

Now former Head of Protocol Support Kaylin Fulton has filed a lawsuit against the Foundation and Vitalik Buterin in Colorado. She claims she was fired for protesting. The court hasn’t ruled on anything yet.

The moral: if a contract contains the word “sword,” ask your lawyer whether it’s a metaphor. And if the answer is “it’s art,” ask again.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
Trading futures is inseparable from USDT, but many people have never wondered why it’s worth $1.

[How it works] Stablecoins are operated by an issuer: you give it $1, it gives you 1 USDT, and puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars goes to the issuer
to redeem it. This “issuance-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to 0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly arbitrage it away.

$630 million—that’s the biggest loss in Binance’s history. You’d think news this big could easily send Bitcoin plunging by half. But Fitch Ratings says Bitcoin fell just 6% this time, a fairly calm reaction compared with past crypto crises. This suggests Bitcoin has become more resilient to risk, and the market is no longer as easily spooked by this kind of breaking news. Think about it: in the past, news of a similar scale would have sent Bitcoin down by much more than 6%.

Impact on the market
- Short term: This event may make the market see Bitcoin as more stable, potentially attracting investors who are just looking for more predictable returns. Funds may flow from other, more volatile cryptocurrencies into Bitcoin.
- Medium term: The industry landscape may tilt toward Bitcoin, as investors become more inclined to choose assets that seem more stable and “too big to fail.” In terms of regulation, this display of maturity may prompt regulators to study Bitcoin more closely rather than simply crack down on it.

My take
Bitcoin’s ability to hold steady this time suggests it’s increasingly becoming a genuine store-of-value asset. But at the end of the day, the crypto market is still full of uncertainty. This “maturity” may only be temporary; if a new black swan event occurs, Bitcoin will still fluctuate. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself.

# 俄罗斯央行允许 BTC、ETH、USDT 面向非专业投资者：准入扩大不等于即时买盘

俄罗斯央行把 Bitcoin、Ether 和 USDT 放进非专业投资者可接触的加密货币名单，规则将于 11 月 17 日生效。真正值得关注的不是“俄罗斯要大规模买币”，而是一个受限的合规入口开始有了明确时间表：单一中介每年最多 30 万卢布，所有投资者还要先通过测试。

## 发生了什么？

俄罗斯央行 11 月 6 日公告称，非专业投资者可通过经纪商、信托管理人或加密货币兑换机构购买 BTC、ETH 和 USDT，交易可以发生在交易所或场外市场；规则从 11 月 17 日起生效。专业投资者则不受这份三资产名单限制。

官方公告：
https://www.cbr.ru/eng/press/event/?id=32966

这不是“俄罗斯交易所已经出现了新的现货净流入”，也不是对所有代币开放零门槛交易。央行明确提到，非专业投资者通过单一中介的年度购买金额上限是 300,000 卢布，并且不论投资者身份都要完成相关测试、阅读风险说明。这个设计更接近受限试点入口，而不是一次性放开零售资金。

## 为什么 BTC、ETH 和 USDT 会被放在一起？

央行给出的筛选思路是市值、日均交易量以及至少五年的境外价格历史。BTC 和 ETH 代表高流动性的波动资产，USDT 则更像交易与计价基础设施。把三者放在同一名单里，并不意味着三种资产的投资逻辑相同：BTC、ETH需要承担价格波动，USDT还要面对发行方、托管、中介和合规渠道风险。

如果要查看 BTC / USDT 现货，可用 Binance 官方页面：
https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/trade/BTC_USDT

如果要查看 BTC / USDT USDⓈ-M 永续，可用：
https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/futures/BTCUSDT

## 盘面现在说明了什么？

北京时间 11 月 10 日约 04:44，Binance API 的 BTCUSDT 现货约 74,779.37 美元，24 小时下跌约 1.413%，报价成交额约 14.67 亿 USDT；BTCUSDT USDⓈ-M 永续约 74,756.50 美元，24 小时下跌约 1.394%，报价成交额约 164.27 亿 USDT，未平仓量约 97,282.624 BTC，资金费率约 +0.0100%/结算周期。

现货与永续价格接近，但永续报价成交额明显更大，说明当前交易活跃度不能简单等同为俄罗斯零售资金已经入场。正资金费率与未平仓量也只描述杠杆仓位状态，不是新规带来买盘的证据。

关联资产 ETH 的 Binance 现货约 2,126.71 美元，24 小时下跌约 4.587%；ETHUSDT USDⓈ-M 永续约 2,125.81 美元，24 小时下跌约 4.575%，报价成交额约 128.96 亿 USDT。ETH 现货入口：
https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/trade/ETH_USDT

ETH USDⓈ-M 永续入口：
https://www.binance.com/zh-CN/futures/ETHUSDT

## 我的判断与失效条件

这条规则对 BTC、ETH 的中期合规可获得性是边际利好，对短线价格却还缺少三项验证：第一，11 月 17 日后是否真的有可用产品；第二，开户、测试、入金和成交是否能顺畅完成；第三，成交量能否持续，而不是发布首日的尝鲜流量。30 万卢布的单一中介年度上限，也决定了不能直接把“可买”换算成大规模资金流入。

如果实际执行延期、参与中介很少、交易规则限制了自托管或成交量很快回落，我会下调“准入扩大带来边际需求”的判断。反过来，如果多家合规中介按期上线，且 BTC、ETH 的现货成交连续增长、并非只有永续 OI 抬升，才更接近可验证的需求变化。

SharpLink’s Q3 net profit was $751 million | Most came from unrealized valuation gains | Wait at 2,129 for ETH

My stance is to view the bullish narrative around companies holding crypto cautiously. Binance Square’s Binance News highlighted SharpLink’s third-quarter net profit of about $751 million, so I went back to verify the figures in the company’s 10-Q filing with the SEC. The report is presented in thousands of dollars: net profit for the three months ended September 30 was about $751.4 million, including about $676.7 million in unrealized gains on the fair value of crypto assets, about $75.22 million in realized net gains on crypto assets, and about $13.06 million in staking income. The profit is a real, disclosed accounting result, but the unrealized portion did not bring in the same amount of cash—and it certainly does not mean SharpLink bought another $676 million of ETH on November 9.

This distinction determines how to assess demand for ETH. Companies holding and staking ETH may create sustained asset allocation and on-chain participation; rising fair values boost the income statement, while falling prices can also cause valuation swings in the next period. The 10-Q also says the company uses native staking and liquid-staking tools, which involve risks related to staking, liquidity, and collateral arrangements. So it is not enough to take the word “profit” and infer net spot buying. The filing disclosed that as of November 2 the company had total economic exposure to about 895,117 ETH, including native ETH and various staking tokens converted on a redeemable basis. This measure includes some assets that retain economic exposure but have been deployed into funds; it does not mean the same number of tokens are all held in company-controlled wallets, nor does it represent new trades today.

The timeline of the news and the market action does not line up. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,128.84, down about 4.56% over 24 hours, with a low of $2,060 and a high of $2,230.91. The company’s profit disclosure for the previous quarter did not prevent risk assets from pulling back that day. Farside’s table showed combined net outflows of about $93.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 6; the breakdown for November 9 was still blank, so the automatically calculated total of 0.0 cannot be treated as confirmation that there were no creations or redemptions. If you mix the third-quarter valuation gains, the November 2 holdings snapshot, the November 6 fund flows, and the current spot price as though they were all from the same point in time, it is easy to reach the false conclusion that “institutions are broadly adding to their positions.”

In the short term, I’m watching whether 2,100 holds and whether 2,060 is tested again; to the upside, 2,150 comes first, followed by 2,200. If the company later formally discloses new net purchases, or the fund breakdown is filled in and flows turn positive for several consecutive periods, while the price recovers 2,200, I could revise my current cautious view upward. If the price falls below 2,060 and stays there, the price action will invalidate any immediate support imagined on the basis of the earnings figures. There is no accurate trending Square topic directly tied to this earnings report, so I won’t force in unrelated macro or liquidation buzzwords.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I’d only consider a small spot position to test a long trade, with no leverage. I’d wait for two full 15-minute candles to close above 2,150, for a pullback to hold 2,140, and for fund flow updates not to show a marked acceleration in outflows. Only then would I enter with no more than 0.25% of total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of 2,180 and close the rest in the 2,200–2,220 range. After entry, if a full 15-minute candle closes back below 2,120, I’d reduce the remaining position by half; at 2,100, I’d stop out of the entire position. If 2,060 breaks before entry, I’d cancel this plan. Earnings reports can explain the past; execution still has to follow the price and risk in front of us.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

SharpLink三季度净利7.51亿美元｜大部分来自未实现估值｜ETH在2129先等

我的态度是谨慎看待企业持币带来的利好叙事。币安广场Binance News把SharpLink三季度净利润约7.51亿美元列为焦点，我回到公司向SEC提交的10-Q核数。该报表的单位是千美元：截至9月30日的三个月净利润约7.514亿美元，其中加密资产公允价值未实现收益约6.767亿美元，已实现加密资产净收益约7522万美元，质押收入约1306万美元。利润是真实披露的会计结果，但未实现部分并非同额现金流入，更不是11月9日又买入6.77亿美元ETH。

这种区分决定了如何看待ETH需求。企业持有并质押ETH，可能形成持续的资产配置和链上参与；公允价值上升会放大利润表，而价格下跌也会使下期估值波动。10-Q还说明公司使用原生质押及流动性质押工具，相关风险包括质押、流动性和抵押安排，因此不能只取“盈利”两个字推算现货净买盘。文件披露截至11月2日公司总ETH经济敞口约895117枚，其中包括原生ETH和多种按可赎回基准折算的质押代币；这一口径含继续具有经济敞口但已投入基金的部分资产，不等于同数量都在企业自托管地址里，也不是今天的新增成交。

新闻与盘面的时间轴并不一致。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约2128.84美元，24小时约跌4.56%，最低2060，最高2230.91；企业上季度利润披露没有阻止当天的风险资产回落。Farside表中11月6日美国现货ETH基金合计净流出约9330万美元，11月9日分项仍为空白，自动合计0.0不能当成确认无申赎。若把三季度估值收益、11月2日持仓快照、11月6日基金净流和现在的现货价混作同一时点，就容易得出错误的“机构全面加仓”判断。

短线我看2100是否守住、2060是否再被测试；向上先看2150，再看2200。若公司后续正式披露新的净购入或基金分项补齐且连续转入，同时价格收复2200，当前谨慎判断可以上修。若跌回2060下方并维持，则任何靠财报数字想象的即时支撑都被价格推翻。广场热门话题没有与这份财报直接对应的准确标签，我不套用别的宏观或清算热词。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只准备小仓位现货试多，不用杠杆。要等两根完整15分钟K线收在2150上方，回踩2140守住，且基金补报没有明显加速流出，才以总资金最多0.25%入场。第一目标2180减半，第二目标2200至2220区间全部平仓；入场后完整15分钟收回2120下方先减余仓一半，跌到2100全部止损平仓。若入场前先失守2060，这个计划取消。财报能说明过去，执行仍要服从眼前的价格和风险。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, buying and selling every day,
until fees and volatility grind their capital away.

In fact, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. Sit out when you can’t make sense of the market,
Sitting out when bulls and bears are at odds, and sitting out after a string of bad trades—money saved in these three moments
can be worth more than what most trades earn.

We’ve all heard the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. When you have capital, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your ammunition.

2026年11月9日，以太坊报价2122美元，过去24小时下跌约4.76%，跌幅明显大于比特币。盘中最低触及2117美元附近，市场抛压沉重，短期走势不容乐观。

一、价格走势分析

从小时K线来看，ETH在过去数小时内呈现阶梯式下跌态势。价格从2147美元附近开盘后持续走低，先后跌破2130美元和2120美元支撑位，最低下探至2117美元。虽然此后出现小幅反弹至2128美元附近，但反弹幅度极为有限，价格始终未能有效收复2130美元。

布林带指标显示，上轨2153美元，中轨2126美元，下轨2099美元。当前价格在中轨附近窄幅波动，布林带开口有所扩大，暗示波动率正在上升。如果价格跌破下轨2099美元，可能加速下行至2070美元甚至更低位置。

成交量方面，下跌阶段单小时成交额达到2723万美元，而反弹阶段成交量迅速萎缩至121万美元，多空力量对比悬殊，空头占据绝对优势。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的空头排列。7周期均线报2131美元，25周期均线报2131美元，99周期均线报2211美元。短期均线已经明显低于中期和长期均线，且99周期均线高悬于2211美元，形成强大的上方压力。价格要扭转弱势，首先需要重新站上25周期均线，然后挑战99周期均线。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线报负14.83，DEA线报负19.68，柱状线为4.85。虽然柱状线连续收窄，显示下跌动能逐步减弱，但两条线均深度处于零轴下方，空头趋势依然牢固。

RSI指标显示，6周期RSI报48.85，12周期RSI报43.11，24周期RSI报39.05。短周期RSI勉强维持在50下方，中长期RSI则深度处于弱势区域，表明整体卖压尚未释放完毕。

KDJ指标中，K值50.88，D值57.67，J值37.31。J值已经跌至37附近，三线呈向下发散态势，短期仍有进一步调整的可能。

综合15个因子来看，多头信号7个，空头信号7个，中性信号1个，多空力量暂时均衡。但复合指标给出空头信号，历史胜率高达87.5%，说明在类似技术形态下，做空的准确率非常高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场面临的最大压力来自机构资金的持续撤离。美国以太坊现货ETF已经连续六周录得净流出，上周流出规模达到3.65亿美元，投资者信心严重受挫。ETF的持续赎回直接减少了市场上的买盘力量，放大了下行波动。

不过链上数据出现了一些积极变化。在价格跌至2070美元附近时，链上鲸鱼地址大量吸筹，单次买入超过10000枚ETH。这些大户的逆势布局通常被视为中长期看多信号，说明聪明钱认为当前价格已经具备投资价值。

以太坊创始人Vitalik Buterin近期公开倡导ETH的价值存储定位，支持EIP-1559手续费销毁机制，这一叙事如果获得更广泛认可，有望为ETH的长期需求提供新的支撑逻辑。

宏观层面，明日CPI数据同样是对ETH的关键考验。如果通胀超预期，加息预期升温将进一步打压ETH等高风险资产。建议投资者密切关注数据公布后的市场反应，控制好仓位和风险。

title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

For every trade, write down three things: why you entered (your rationale), what went wrong or right (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll change next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses
A lot of the same types of mistakes keep recurring in your trades—for example, always reversing your position immediately after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change automatically unless you keep an eye on them and work to correct them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your transaction records.

【Today's Macroeconomic and Political Analysis | November 10】

The market's main focus today is not the short-term fluctuations of any single asset, but the interplay between inflation data, interest rate expectations, and changes in the U.S. political landscape.

The U.S. will release its latest Consumer Price Index (CPI). The CPI will directly affect the market's expectations for the Federal Reserve's next policy moves. If inflation comes in higher than expected, the market may reprice how long interest rates will remain high, potentially increasing liquidity pressures on risk assets. If inflation cools, it could ease concerns about further monetary tightening.

The labor market has been strong so far, suggesting that the U.S. economy has not yet shown clear signs of losing momentum. With inflation still sticky, it will be difficult for the Fed to shift quickly toward easing. Whether it raises rates again in December or keeps them high will be a key topic of market discussion in the days ahead.

Politically, following the U.S. midterm elections, the Democratic Party gained control of both chambers of Congress. Congressional oversight, investigations, and policy battles may increase significantly over the next two years. The market structure bill that the crypto industry had hoped for may be harder to advance, while trading platforms, DeFi, and politically connected projects will face greater scrutiny.

However, tighter regulation does not mean the entire industry has lost room to grow. Areas such as stablecoins, blockchain payments, and asset tokenization may still advance within the existing legal framework. The industry may become more clearly divided: projects with stronger compliance may find more opportunities, while areas lacking transparency and a regulatory foundation face greater pressure.

My view:

At the macro level, inflation and interest rate expectations remain cautious; politically, regulatory uncertainty is increasing; within the industry, stablecoins and asset tokenization are relatively more worth watching.

It's not wise to read too much into any single data point today, nor do I recommend blindly chasing a rally based on short-term news. 就业市场此前表现较强，说明美国经济暂时还没有出现明显失速。在通胀仍有粘性的情况下，美联储很难快速转向宽松，12月是否继续加息或维持高利率，将成为接下来市场讨论的重点。

宏观层面，通胀和利率预期仍然偏谨慎；政治层面，监管不确定性上升；行业层面，稳定币和资产代币化相对更值得关注。

During Devcon 8, Vitalik published a long post that officially shifted the core valuation logic of $ETH  toward “store of value” and underlying collateral. The “ultrasound money” and deflationary burn narratives that the community had emphasized repeatedly over the past three years have essentially come to an end. The cash-flow models celebrated during the previous bull market relied entirely on high-frequency on-chain leverage and speculative activity that burned through gas. But now Layer 2 has drained most of the mainnet’s transaction volume and fees, leaving the original burn mechanism all but dead. In response to this shift, institutions have already begun to act: Tom Lee’s Bitmine has taken the opportunity to add another $20 million, bringing its holdings to 6.07 million $ETH  (nearly 5% of the total supply). Staking rewards alone could bring in a steady $309 million a year.

My view is that Ethereum faces a very difficult road ahead. Stop fooling yourselves with the old logic that deflation will drive a massive price surge. Without mainnet fee revenue to support it, $ETH  has no choice but to pursue a pure collateral and store-of-value narrative. The key question now is whether Wall Street will buy into its role as an “underlying yield-bearing collateral asset.” The market may go through a prolonged period of valuation reassessment. Ordinary investors should avoid blindly chasing prices or using high leverage during this period, and instead pay close attention to institutions’ willingness to absorb the supply.

As the narrative shifts from a deflationary asset to pure collateral, do you think institutions will keep adding to their positions or gradually exit?

我的判断是，以太坊接下来的路会非常艰难。大家别再抱着靠通缩推动暴涨的旧逻辑自欺欺人，在失去了主网手续费现金流支撑后，$ETH 只能硬着头皮走向纯粹的抵押品和价值储存路线。接下来核心要看华尔街对这种「底层生息抵押物」的定位到底买不买单，市场可能会经历一段漫长的估值重塑期，普通投资者切忌在这个阶段盲目追高或上高杠杆，多观察机构资金的承接意愿。

【Down 4.9% in a day, 5.7% in a week, and 15.5% in a month: Is ETH being reshuffled?】

First, a platform-related update: According to CoinDesk and Cointelegraph, North Korean hackers used memecoins to launder the $6.3 billion in stolen funds from Binance; analysts believe there is no broader “contagion.” The details have yet to be confirmed by Binance. The impact on ETH lies in exchange risk and the flow of funds on-chain.

Bitmine added 20 million ETH, bringing its holdings to 6.07 million, or 4.97% of the supply. The price fell 15.5% over the month, yet large holders kept buying. This doesn’t confirm a bottom; it points to tokens becoming more concentrated in institutional hands. translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle, so I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch; don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is money; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong; it’s that their execution goes off track. Let’s encourage each other.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Get Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year works out to 12x; a steady 10% a month,
works out to 30x over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one amazing feature—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are waited for, while discipline is yours. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week”; set it as “making zero major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

EU invites industry to set tokenization standards｜Ethereum settlement not specified｜I’ll wait while ETH is near 2,126

My view is to treat regulatory developments as a medium- to long-term point to watch, not to interpret “the EU is discussing tokenization” as a direct buy signal for ETH. The exact trending topic on Binance Square is #EUInstitutionsInviteIndustryToSetTokenizedSecuritiesStandards. In its November 9 announcement, the European Commission said that the European Central Bank, the European Commission, and the European Securities and Markets Authority have invited the wholesale financial industry to participate in a European tokenization standards working group, with applications due by November 27. The group plans to discuss interoperability standards between different distributed ledgers and traditional financial systems. It will be chaired by industry representatives, with the three institutions acting as observers. This is only the starting point for recruiting members and developing standards—not a new regulation that has already taken effect, and certainly not an announcement that securities will be settled on the Ethereum mainnet.

Why is this news worth watching for ETH traders? Genuine institutional tokenization requires asset registration, custody, cross-platform transfers, and final settlement to work together. If future standards allow open networks to participate, the Ethereum ecosystem’s tools, developers, and existing experience issuing assets could create opportunities. But institutions could also choose permissioned chains, other public blockchains, or direct connections to central bank monetary systems. Even if securities are issued on an Ethereum layer 2 network, increased on-chain activity does not necessarily translate proportionally into spot buying of ETH. It also matters which layer handles final settlement, what is used to pay gas fees, and how institutions manage their holdings. This is a question of competition and adoption; the working group’s name is not proof that “ETH has received EU endorsement.”

In the short term, the market clearly has not priced this announcement as positive news. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,125.61, down about 4.90% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,235.30 and a low of $2,060. The price move cannot be attributed to the EU announcement alone: equity-market risk appetite, liquidations of leveraged positions, and macroeconomic expectations are all affecting crypto assets at the same time. Farside’s ETH fund breakdown for November 9 is still incomplete, so the provisional total currently shown on the page should not be treated as confirmed fund flows. Technically, I’m watching $2,060 as the day’s low, $2,140–$2,160 as the near-term recovery zone, and around $2,235 as the intraday ceiling. If the price cannot reclaim $2,160, the institutional narrative will not be enough to offset current selling pressure. If it falls below $2,060 and fails to recover on a retest, the recovery thesis is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and only consider a small spot position to test a long. The entry trigger would be an hourly close back above $2,160, followed by a retest that holds between $2,140 and $2,160, with BTC also stabilizing. If all conditions are met, I would invest no more than 0.4% of my total capital, without leverage. The first target is $2,200, where I would take half off; the second target is $2,235, where I would close the remaining position. After entry, if the hourly close falls back below $2,120, I would reduce the position by half; below $2,090, I would exit the entire position at a loss. If the price breaks below $2,060 first, I would cancel the long plan. I would only give this news more weight in my valuation once the working group produces specific, actionable standards and there is evidence of real institutional projects and on-chain settlement activity.

Sources: the European Commission’s November 9 announcement, public ETH/USDT market data on Binance, and Farside’s fund-flow table. #EUInstitutionsInviteIndustryToSetTokenizedSecuritiesStandards #ETH

This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是把监管进展当成中长期观察点，不把“欧盟谈代币化”直接翻译成买入ETH。币安广场当前准确热题是#EUInstitutionsInviteIndustryToSetTokenizedSecuritiesStandards。欧盟委员会11月9日公告：欧洲央行、欧盟委员会和欧盟证券及市场管理局邀请批发金融业参与欧洲代币化标准工作组，申请截至11月27日。工作组拟讨论不同分布式账本及传统金融系统之间的互操作标准，由行业人士主持，三家机构作为观察员。现在只是征集成员和制定标准的起点，不是新法规已经生效，更没有宣布用以太坊主网结算证券。

这条消息为什么值得ETH交易者看？真正的机构代币化需要资产登记、托管、跨平台转移和最终结算相互衔接。若未来标准允许开放网络参与，Ethereum生态的工具、开发者和现有资产发行经验可能得到机会。但机构也可以选择许可链、其他公链或与央行货币系统直连。即便证券在以太坊某条二层网络发行，链上交易增长也不必然等比例转化成ETH现货买盘；还要看最终结算落在哪一层、Gas用什么支付、机构如何管理库存。这是竞争与采用问题，不能从工作组名称推导“ETH已获欧盟背书”。

短线市场显然没有按这则公告定价为利好。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约2125.61美元，24小时跌约4.90%，最高2235.30、最低2060。价格变化不能单独归因于欧盟公告，股市风险偏好、杠杆清算与宏观预期同时在影响加密资产。Farside的11月9日ETH基金分项仍未填全，也不能把页面暂时的合计值当成确认的资金流。技术上我看2060为当天低点，2140至2160为近端修复区，2235附近为日内上沿。若价格始终无法收回2160，所谓机构叙事无法抵消当前卖压；若跌破2060并反抽失败，修复判断就被推翻。

Honestly, I’ve cheated while I was in a relationship too. But the interesting thing is, before I actually cheated, I never thought I was the kind of person who would.

Sometimes, the more convinced you are that you’d never do something, the more likely you are to underestimate the chance of losing control in a particular situation. If that makes me a shitty person, then I’m the kind who moves straight from one relationship to the next. Many of my past relationships had no cooling-off period, and I never go back once a relationship is over. Going back to deal with an old relationship is much harder than starting a new one.

The best choice when a relationship between a man and a woman develops cracks is to move on to the next journey as soon as possible.

I’ve never paid for sex either. It’s too utilitarian—a way to satisfy a physical need—and it’s boring and a waste of time. Nor have I ever expected any relationship to last a lifetime. You have to think about what you’re going to eat at your next meal; it’s even less realistic to think about how to live peacefully with someone else for the rest of your life.

As for whether I might spend my life peacefully with someone of the opposite sex in the future, I don’t know. Life may be short, or it may be long. Making the most of the present is the best choice.

Romance, marriage, and the family system have never been humanity’s only options. Monogamy isn’t a social institution humans are born with, either. It evolved over time in different civilizations under the influence of productivity, property relations, social organization, and cultural constraints.

The views on marriage, love, and morality that we hold today are, to a large extent, products of long-standing social institutions.

But institutions have never truly eliminated human instincts.

At the level of instinct, men and women are the same. Sexual attraction, desire, and emotional attachment are, after all, mechanisms that don’t entirely overlap.

From a certain perspective, sexual relationships themselves may not be all that complicated. More often, they’re the result of physical urges, emotional needs, and social ideology acting together.

Society has always tried to use institutions to restrain our instincts, but that doesn’t mean instincts disappear just because those institutions exist.

We can choose to follow a particular relationship model, but there’s no need to assume that doing so means we’ve transcended human nature.

截至二零二六年十一月九日，比特币现货价格报七万四千八百零八美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点九。盘中一度下探至七万三千五百一十美元的多月低点，随后在现货买盘的推动下反弹至七万五千零七十美元附近。从小时级别K线来看，最近五根K线呈现先涨后跌的格局，成交量在冲高时放大至九千五百万美元级别，随后逐步萎缩至一千二百万美元，显示多头力量在高位遭遇明显抛压。

从更宏观的视角来看，比特币近期受到多重利空因素冲击。美国中期选举后民主党重掌国会两院，市场对加密货币监管趋严的担忧急剧升温。标普五百指数单日暴跌百分之四点四，创下二零二五年四月以来最大跌幅，风险资产全线承压。此外，英伟达首席执行官丑闻引发科技股大跌，连带加密市场出现超过十亿美元的多头清算。比特币现货ETF上周净流出达十二亿八千万美元，为六月以来最大单周流出，机构去风险化趋势明显。

二、技术指标解读

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold a Losing Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% look at? They look at the “all-time high” and tell themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you start holding a losing position, you automatically seek out positive news and block out negative news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned through more money in history than any hacker ever has.

The cure is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from the act of holding a position, and only then can you see clearly.

The decline in tech stocks is also part of the market narrative, but it does not prove the cause of every ETH sell order.

When leveraged longs fall below maintenance margin, forced selling can accelerate the decline and trigger the next wave of liquidations. This can push short-term prices away from fundamentals. But the end of liquidations does not mean an automatic rebound: without enough spot buying, a bounce may be no more than short covering. CoinGlass shows a decline in futures open interest, but that alone cannot distinguish between voluntary position closures, forced liquidations, or transfers across platforms. I'm more concerned with whether spot demand supports any rebound.

Checking the Binance ETH/USDT quote, the latest price is about $2,126.14, with a 24-hour open of about $2,226.08, a high of $2,237.35, and a low of $2,060, down about 4.49%. This is consistent with leveraged pressure, but does not establish a single cause. Farside's breakdown of U.S. ETH spot funds for November 9 was still blank at the time; the 0.0 in the total column should not be treated as confirmation of zero inflows. On the macro front, U.S. inflation data and the Federal Reserve's future policy path will continue to affect discount rates for risk assets, but unpublished data cannot be prematurely characterized as bullish or bearish. Nor does a price decline mean that the Ethereum network itself has suffered a protocol failure.

In the short term, I'll first watch whether the recent low of $2,060 is tested again, then the rebound resistance near $2,160 and the 24-hour high of $2,237. If price breaks below $2,060 and cannot reclaim it on a rebound, that would suggest the deleveraging shock could still spread. title: Bitcoin Slips to a Two-Month Low as $1.28 Billion Leaves ETFs: Is $73,170 the Level to Watch?
subTitle:
Bitcoin is facing a real confidence test as institutional money moves out and leveraged traders take heavy losses. With $BTC near $74,500 to $75,000 and major US inflation data due, the next few days could shape sentiment for both Bitcoin and Ethereum.
📉 1. What Happened This Weekend?
Bitcoin dropped to about $73,500 over the weekend, its lowest level since August. It has since traded around $74,500 to $75,000, far below its all-time high of $126,198 from October 6, 2025. Selling pressure is now showing up alongside weaker institutional demand.
The wider market also saw a major liquidation event. About $1.1 billion in leveraged long positions were wiped out. Liquidations happen when traders using borrowed money cannot keep their positions open. Exchanges then close those trades by force, which can add more selling pressure.
💸 2. Why ETF Outflows and Liquidations Matter
Institutional flows are a key concern. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.28 billion in net outflows last week, their largest weekly withdrawals since late June. US spot Ethereum ETFs saw $365.2 million in withdrawals between November 2 and 6.
ETF outflows do not mean institutions have left crypto. But steady withdrawals can weaken an important source of buying demand. Combined with $1.1 billion in liquidations, the market faces fewer buyers and more forced selling. The key question is whether long-term holders and new buyers can absorb the supply.
⚖️ 3. $ETH vs $BTC: Why Ether Is Weaker
Ethereum is lagging Bitcoin. $ETH trades around $2,120 to $2,145, down about 5% on the day and 7% on the week. The ETH/BTC ratio has fallen to 0.0283, its lowest level since July. This means Ether is losing ground against Bitcoin.
For $ETH, the immediate battle is near $2,100 support, with resistance around $2,200. Support is a price area where buyers may try to stop a decline. Resistance is where selling pressure may return. If Ether struggles while Bitcoin stabilizes, it could point to continued weakness across altcoins.
🌍 4. What to Watch This Week: CPI, PPI and the 200-Day Average
The macro calendar could be the next big catalyst. The US October jobs report showed 165,000 new jobs, which keeps higher interest rate risk in focus. October CPI inflation data is due Tuesday, followed by the Producer Price Index (PPI), which tracks prices received by producers. Hot inflation numbers could pressure risk assets like $BTC and $ETH.
On the chart, Bitcoin's 200-day moving average sits near $73,170. Traders use this long-term trend line to judge market strength. The weekend low of $73,500 came close to it. The Fear & Greed Index is at 29, showing fear across the market. A sustained hold above the average could support stabilization, while a clear break below it could raise downside risk.
Closing Summary
Bitcoin's decline reflects ETF withdrawals, leveraged liquidations and macro uncertainty. For $BTC, the $73,170 200-day average is the key level to watch. $ETH needs to defend $2,100 and improve against Bitcoin. This week's CPI and PPI reports could decide whether the market stabilizes or sees another wave of selling. This is market analysis, not financial advice.

📰 Just said eurozone stablecoins hit a record high, and now banks may be stepping in

Just the other day, I mentioned that the supply of eurozone stablecoins had reached a record high of €75 billion. This showed that regulation was working, but also raised concerns about issuer concentration and competition from banks. Now, this market is suddenly facing competitive pressure from traditional finance, as the EU has approved plans for major banks to issue their own stablecoins. This means the rules of the game are about to change.

Why does this news matter?
The root cause is that the boundaries between digital currencies and traditional finance are blurring. In the past, crypto stablecoins were mainly issued by their own projects. But now that banks are entering the market, a large pool of reputable, liquid capital could flow in. This challenges existing stablecoin issuers and could reshape the entire crypto market. How does this relate to other recent developments? For example, people have been discussing central bank digital currencies. Now European banks are getting into stablecoin issuance first—is this an indirect way of paving the road for CBDCs?

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC and ETH may not be significant, since this is an internal eurozone matter. But it could mean that banks in other regions may get involved in similar ways in the future, indirectly affecting global stablecoin pricing. As for the market landscape, the stablecoin sector could shift from its current concentration toward greater diversity. Some funds may move from project-issued stablecoins to bank-issued ones, but we don't yet know how much.

Trading approach
💡 This news is likely to affect market sentiment more than anything else, with no immediate direct impact on prices. But in the long term, intensifying competition in the stablecoin sector could lead to some adjustments in the valuation framework of the broader crypto market. This view would no longer hold if we see large-scale redemptions of project-issued stablecoins in favor of bank-issued stablecoins.

前两天刚说过欧元区稳定币供应量创新高，达到了750亿欧元，这显示了监管成功但也带来发行方集中和银行竞争的风险。现在这个市场突然要面对来自传统金融的竞争压力，因为欧盟批准了大型银行发行自己的稳定币计划，这意味着游戏规则要变了。

这件事的根本原因在于数字货币和传统金融的边界正在模糊。过去加密货币稳定币主要靠项目方自己发行，但现在银行入场意味着会有一大批有信誉和流动性的资金进入这个市场。这既是对现有稳定币发行方的一种挑战，也是对整个加密市场格局的重新洗牌。和近期其他事件有什么关联？比如之前大家讨论的央行数字货币，现在欧洲银行自己先搞起了稳定币发行，这算不算变相给CBDC铺路？

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn’t admitting you’re wrong; it’s buying a ticket to the next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most disciplined traders I’ve seen are quicker than anyone to accept a loss. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. Next time your hand trembles as you set a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Structural Concerns Amid a Weak Rebound

I. Price Trend Review

As of the early hours of November 10, 2026, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,133, having experienced sharp volatility over the past 24 hours. The price briefly fell to around $2,093, touching a recent low, before rebounding to $2,151 on dip-buying, then retreating to consolidate around $2,130. The latest five hourly candlesticks show a rise followed by a pullback: the price climbed from $2,125 to $2,147 before encountering resistance and falling back. Trading volume peaked at $33.88 million per hour during the rebound, then gradually contracted to $2.12 million, indicating that bullish momentum behind the rebound was limited. Notably, Ethereum has fallen nearly 15% cumulatively over the past five trading days, with a clear downward trend.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving averages are in a bearish alignment. The 7-hour moving average is at $2,128, the 25-hour moving average at $2,144, and the 99-hour moving average at $2,215. The price is trading below all major moving averages, while the short-, medium-, and long-term averages are diverging downward, indicating bearish trends across all timeframes. The upper Bollinger Band is at $2,155, the middle band at $2,127, and the lower band at $2,099. The price is hovering near the middle band, and the short-term trading range is narrowing, potentially setting the stage for a directional breakout.

The MACD indicator shows a DIFF value of -17.84, a DEA value of -23.34, and a positive histogram reading of 5.51 that has expanded for four consecutive periods. This indicates that although the overall market remains in bearish territory, downward momentum is gradually weakening. As for RSI, the 6-period RSI is 49.55, the 12-period RSI is 43.19, and the 24-period RSI is 38.99. The short-period RSI has recovered from oversold territory to a neutral level, but the medium- and long-period RSI readings remain low, reflecting an unchanged medium-term weakness. For the KDJ indicator, K is 67.83, D is 64.96, and J is 73.58. All three lines have fallen from elevated levels, suggesting further short-term pullback pressure.

Quantitative factor statistics show that only 6 of 15 factors are signaling long positions, while 8 are signaling short positions. The proportion of short signals is 53.3%, notably higher than Bitcoin's. The composite indicator is signaling a short position, with an 81.82% win rate. The model has a high degree of accuracy in identifying bearish Ethereum signals, so investors should be especially cautious.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing multiple headwinds. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for six consecutive weeks, with outflows totaling $365 million last week. The continued withdrawal of institutional funds has severely undermined market confidence. Previously, a large investor liquidated more than 30,000 Ethereum long positions using a TWAP strategy, triggering spot-market net outflows of as much as $48.7 million per hour and briefly driving the price sharply down to $2,093.

However, on-chain data shows that whale investors are positioning against the trend. One large investor bought 10,000 Ethereum near the lows, worth approximately $21.5 million, indicating that long-term holders see value at current prices. Bitmine also added 9,587 Ethereum, providing some support at the bottom. Ethereum founder Vitalik Buterin recently suggested that Ethereum should be viewed as a store-of-value asset rather than merely a gas-consuming product, in an effort to reshape the market narrative. In the short term, however, this shift in perspective has yet to effectively reverse the downtrend.

At the macroeconomic level, Tuesday's U.S. CPI data this week will be a key catalyst. If inflation comes in higher than expected, expectations of interest rate hikes will intensify, putting greater pressure on risk assets such as Ethereum. Technically, $2,100 is an important psychological support level; a break below it could lead to a test of the $2,000 round-number threshold. The $2,150–$2,170 area above presents short-term resistance that may be difficult to overcome. Investors are advised to remain cautious and wait until the CPI data is released before making decisions.

以太坊市场深度分析：弱势反弹中的结构性隐忧

一、价格走势回顾

截至北京时间2026年11月10日凌晨，以太坊报价2133美元，过去24小时内经历了剧烈波动。价格一度跌至2093美元附近，触及近期低点，随后在抄底资金推动下反弹至2151美元，最终回落至2130美元一线整理。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现冲高回落态势，从2125美元上涨至2147美元后承压回落，成交量在反弹高峰时达到每小时3388万美元，随后逐步萎缩至212万美元，显示多头反弹力度有限。值得注意的是，以太坊在过去五个交易日内累计跌幅接近15%，下行趋势明显。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现空头排列格局。7小时均线报2128美元，25小时均线报2144美元，99小时均线报2215美元。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，且短中长期均线呈发散向下态势，表明各周期趋势均偏空。布林带上轨位于2155美元，中轨2127美元，下轨2099美元，价格在中轨附近徘徊，短期波动区间收窄，可能酝酿方向突破。

MACD指标显示，DIFF值为负17.84，DEA值为负23.34，柱状图为正值5.51且连续四个周期放大，表明虽然整体仍处于空头区域，但下跌动能正在逐步减弱。RSI方面，6周期RSI为49.55，12周期RSI为43.19，24周期RSI为38.99，短周期RSI从超卖区域回升至中性水平，但中长周期RSI仍偏低，反映中期弱势格局未改。KDJ指标中K值为67.83，D值为64.96，J值为73.58，三线从高位回落，短期存在进一步回调压力。

量化因子统计显示，15个因子中仅有6个发出做多信号，8个发出做空信号，做空占比达53.3%，明显高于比特币的做空比例。复合指标发出做空信号，胜率为81.82%，模型对以太坊空头信号的判断准确度较高，投资者需格外警惕。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重压力。美国现货以太坊ETF已连续六周净流出，上周流出规模达3.65亿美元，机构资金持续撤离严重打击市场信心。此前有大户通过TWAP策略清算超过3万枚以太坊多头仓位，引发现货市场每小时净流出高达4870万美元，价格一度急挫至2093美元。

不过链上数据显示，鲸鱼资金正在逆势布局。一位大户在低位买入1万枚以太坊，价值约2150万美元，显示长期持有者对当前价值的认可。Bitmine也增持了9587枚以太坊，为价格提供了一定的底部支撑。以太坊创始人Vitalik Buterin近期提出应将以太坊视为价值存储资产而非单纯的Gas消耗品，试图重塑市场叙事，但从短期来看，这一观点转变尚未有效扭转跌势。

宏观层面，本周二美国CPI数据将成为关键催化剂。若通胀数据高于预期，加息预期将进一步升温，对以太坊等风险资产构成更大压力。技术面上，2100美元是重要心理支撑位，若跌破可能下探2000美元整数关口。上方2150至2170美元区域构成短期阻力，突破难度较大。建议投资者保持谨慎，等待CPI数据落地后再做决策。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “compounding positions” has been all the rage lately. The stories are always the same: use several times leverage on a small amount of capital to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times
and multiply it dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What compounding positions involves】Unrealized profits aren’t cashed out; instead, they’re treated as risk capital for new positions to keep opening trades,
It's like using the market's money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
a few dozen points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “being right repeatedly.” If the win rate is 60% each time, the probability of being right four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling In: How to Add to a Trend Position as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve correctly identified the trend and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in from the start and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized profits is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A common sight. The right approach is called pyramid scaling in.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the previous time. For example: start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your profit into a loss. Once you lose your composure, your whole trading plan falls apart.

title: تحليل سيناريو CPI هو نقطة الحسم.
subTitle:
سأفصّل هنا تأثير السيناريوهين على #BTC ، ثم أضيف تحليلاً محدثاً للإيثريوم ( #ETH ) كأصل محدد في هذا السياق.
📊 أولاً: سيناريوهات #CPI  الثلاثة وتأثيرها على BTC
الأرقام الأهم غداً (الثلاثاء 10 نوفمبر) ليست الرقم السنوي، بل قراءة CPI الأساسي الشهري (Core MoM). الأرقام السنوية لشهر أكتوبر قد لا تُنشر أصلاً بسبب فجوة بيانات من إغلاق حكومي سابق، لذا التركيز كله على الأساسي الشهري. التوقعات تشير إلى 0.2% أساسي شهري، مقابل 0.3% في سبتمبر.

1. السيناريو "المتفائل" — Core CPI ≤ 0.2% (الأساسي يبرد)
· ماذا يعني: التضخم الأساسي يتحسن باتجاه هدف الفيدرالي، مما يمنحه ذريعة لتأجيل الرفع.
· تأثير BTC: ارتداد ميكانيكي محتمل مدعوم بإغلاق مراكز بيعية (Short Covering). لكن السقف محدود: حتى لو جاءت القراءة باردة، فمن غير المرجح أن تمنع الفيدرالي من رفع الفائدة في ديسمبر، لأن التضخم لا يزال بعيداً عن 2% وسوق العمل قوي. لذا أي ارتداد سيواجه بيعاً عند 76,000$ – 77,700$ (منطقة مقاومة سابقة).
· الإبطال: فشل BTC في الإغلاق فوق 76,000$ يعني أن الارتداد "ميكانيكي" وليس انعكاساً.

2. السيناريو "السلبي" — Core CPI = 0.3% أو أعلى (الأساسي ثابت)

· ماذا يعني: التضخم الأساسي "عالق" (Sticky)، ورفع ديسمبر يصبح شبه مؤكد (احتمال يتجاوز 80% الحالي).
· تأثير BTC: هذا هو السيناريو الأخطر. التحليل يشير إلى أن "الضربة" على BTC ستكون أكبر من الأسهم، لأن سلسلة نقل تشديد السيولة إلى الكريبتو "أقصر وأكثر حدة". مع تمركز شرائي لا يزال موجوداً (نسبة Long/Short عند 58/42 وتقلصت لكنها لم تنعكس)، قد نشهد موجة تصفية ثانية تدفع السعر لكسر 75,000$** نحو **73,000$ ثم 71,000$.
· الشرط: كسر 75,000$ بإغلاق 4 ساعات، مع استمرار غياب المشترين الفوريين (Spot ETF).

3. السيناريو "المرعب" — Core CPI = 0.4%+ (تسارع أساسي)

· ماذا يعني: التضخم الأساسي يتسارع شهرياً، مما يفتح الباب أمام رفع 50 نقطة أساس في ديسمبر بدلاً من 25 (سيناريو طرحته تحليلات سابقة).
· تأثير BTC: "ليس تصحيحاً، بل إزالة قسرية للرافعة المالية" (Forced Deleveraging). هذا قد يكسر 73,000$** بسرعة ويستهدف **68,000$ – 69,000$ (منطقة Fibonacci Golden Pocket) خلال أيام. مؤشر الخوف قد ينتقل من "خوف" (26) إلى "خوف شديد" (<25)، وهو ما لم يحدث بعد في هذه الموجة.

الخلاصة العملية لـ CPI: السوق لا يزال في وضع "لا شراء قبل التأكيد". أي مركز شرائي يجب أن ينتظر إما (أ) قراءة أساسي ≤0.2% مع إغلاق 4 ساعات فوق 76,000$، أو (ب) هبوط إلى 68,000–69,000$ مع إشارة بيع ذعر (Capit..ulation) على مؤشرات on-chain. البيع عند المقاومة يبقى الخيار الأقل خطراً في السيناريوهات السلبية.

🔷 ثانياً: تحليل محدث للإيثريوم (ETH) — الأصل الأضعف هيكلياً

اخترت ETH لأنه الأكثر تضرراً في هذه الموجة، ويقدم صورة أوضح عن مخاطر السوق.

السعر الحالي: **~2,107$** (هبوط 5.69% يومي)، بعد تداول بين 2,060$ و2,246$.

هيكل السوق: هابط بوضوح. ETH فقد المتوسط 200 يوم (2,154$)، ويتداول تحت **جميع المتوسطات** (7 أيام: 2,235$، 20 يوماً: 2,295$، 50 يوماً: 2,472$). هذا يعني أن أي ارتداد يواجه سحابة مقاومة من المتوسطات وليس مستوى واحداً.

السيولة والمستويات:

· الدعم الفوري: 2,029$** (دعم مباشر)، ثم **1,951$ (دعم قوي). بعض المحللين يشيرون إلى 1,963$** كهدف إذا استمر البيع ، وآخرون يرون **1,850$ كدعم أبعد (~18% تحت السعر الحالي).
· المقاومة: 2,137$** (المحور اليومي) هي أول عائق. استعادتها هي "أول إشارة استقرار". بعدها **2,215$ لتحسين الهيكل قصير الأجل، ثم 2,323$ لبدء بناء اتجاه أقوى.

المشتقات (تحذير رئيسي):

· الفائدة المفتوحة ( #OI ) ارتفعت 8.8% خلال 24 ساعة إلى 5.27 مليار دولار، بينما السعر يهبط. هذا بناء مراكز جديدة في الجانب الخاسر (Longs)، وهي إشارة هبوطية.
· نسبة Long/Short: حسابات Binance العالمية 79.5% شراء، وكبار المتداولين 80.4% شراء. هذا تمركز شرائي كثيف جداً، مما يبقي خطر موجة تصفية طويلة (Long Squeeze) قائماً.
· معدل التمويل: سالب طفيف (-0.0083%)، أي البائعون يدفعون للمشترين، لكنه قريب من الحياد ولا يكفي وحده لتأكيد انعكاس.

السيناريو لـ ETH:

· هابط (الأرجح): كسر 2,029$** → استهداف **1,951$، ثم 1,850$ إذا استمر ضغط البيع. هذا السيناريو مدعوم بتمركز Longs الكثيف وهيكل المتوسطات.
· صعودي (يحتاج تأكيداً قوياً): استعادة 2,137$** أولاً، ثم **2,215$. فقط اختراق **2,323$** يغير الصورة الهيكلية. لا يُنصح بالدخول شراءً قبل إغلاق 4 ساعات فوق 2,137$ على الأقل.

💎 الخلاصة التنفيذية

غداً هو اختبار حقيقي وليس مجرد حدث. BTC على آخر دعم أسبوعي رئيسي (75,500$)**، وETH فقد **المتوسط 200 يوم** مع تمركز شرائي خطير في المشتقات. **قراءة الأساسي الشهري** هي المفتاح: 0.2% أو أقل = ارتداد محدود؛ 0.3% = كسر 75 ألف؛ 0.4%+ = تصفية قسرية نحو 68-69 ألف. **لا مركز شرائي قبل تأكيد إغلاق فوق 76,000$ (BTC) أو 2,137$ (ETH)، مع مراقبة تدفقات ETF يومياً كإشارة استقرار أساسية.

In the ERC-4337 flow, users sign a UserOperation, which a Bundler collects and submits to the EntryPoint contract for execution.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#仓位管理 #风控 #交易干货 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Have to Be Able to Afford Losses to Survive Long-Term
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 USDT on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down only 20%, a few winning trades can get you back on track. But if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—mathematically, you’re basically finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%”; it’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must be no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out the position size.

title: Binance опинилася перед серйозним регуляторним викликом у Європейському Союзі.
subTitle:
Binance і фінал MiCA: чому чотири країни ЄС можуть втратити доступ до біржі та що це означає для крипторинку
DVA — факти без хайпу
ФАКТ • МЕХАНІЗМ • ЕКОНОМІКА • РИЗИК • DECISION
1. ФАКТ: європейський ринок змінює правила гри
Binance опинилася перед серйозним регуляторним викликом у Європейському Союзі. За повідомленнями про майбутні обмеження, до 31 грудня 2026 року мають бути закриті рахунки певних категорій клієнтів у Франції, Італії, Іспанії та Польщі.
Причина — відсутність необхідної авторизації відповідно до європейського регламенту MiCA.
Йдеться не просто про технічне обмеження роботи біржі. Це демонстрація нової моделі європейського крипторинку, де навіть найбільші міжнародні платформи повинні відповідати єдиним регуляторним вимогам.
Важливо: обмеження не означають автоматичного припинення всієї діяльності Binance в Європі.
2. MECHANISM: що таке MiCA і чому вона важлива
MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation) — Регламент ЄС 2023/1114, який створює єдину правову систему для криптовалютного сектору.
Він передбачає:
ліцензування постачальників криптовалютних послуг (CASP);вимоги до прозорості та корпоративного управління;захист клієнтських активів;контроль за діяльністю криптоплатформ;відповідальність компаній перед користувачами.
Одна з ключових особливостей — принцип європейського паспорта. Компанія, яка отримала відповідну авторизацію в одній державі ЄС і виконала процедури повідомлення, може надавати дозволені послуги в інших країнах Союзу.
Отже, MiCA створює не просто систему дозволів, а спільний регуляторний простір.
3. РЕГУЛЯТОРНИЙ КОНФЛІКТ: глобальна біржа проти європейських правил
Проблема Binance полягає в необхідності узгодити глобальну бізнес-модель із вимогами європейського законодавства.
Особливу увагу привертає поняття reverse solicitation — звернення клієнта з власної ініціативи до компанії з третьої країни.
Цей механізм передбачений статтею 61 MiCA, але не є універсальним способом обходу ліцензування. Він має вузькі умови застосування і не дозволяє компаніям активно просувати послуги на європейському ринку під виглядом ініціативи клієнта.
Фактично регулятори встановлюють межу між міжнародною доступністю сервісу та законним наданням фінансових послуг на території ЄС.
4. ЕКОНОМІКА: ціна невиведених активів
За повідомленнями про нові умови обслуговування клієнтів, яких стосуються обмеження, передбачено щомісячну плату за залишки криптоактивів:

0,025% від балансу;мінімум 10 USDC;можливе списання з балансу USDC або інших активів відповідно до умов платформи.
Для невеликих рахунків мінімальна плата може виявитися непропорційно високою.
Наприклад, для залишку 500 USDC плата 10 USDC становить 2% балансу за один місяць.
Це створює додатковий економічний стимул не залишати кошти на рахунку, який підлягає закриттю.
Однак конкретні строки, порядок списання та наслідки для залишків необхідно звіряти з індивідуальним повідомленням Binance. Не слід ототожнювати припинення обслуговування з автоматичною конфіскацією коштів.
5. РИНОК: хто може виграти від ситуації
Посилення регулювання створює конкурентні переваги для платформ, які вже отримали необхідні європейські дозволи.
Серед гравців, які розвивають європейський напрямок у межах MiCA, — Coinbase, Kraken та Bybit.
Механізм європейського паспорта дозволяє авторизованим компаніям розширювати діяльність у межах ЄС без необхідності отримувати окрему повну ліцензію в кожній країні.
Потенційні наслідки:

перерозподіл торгових обсягів;перехід частини користувачів до конкурентів;збільшення попиту на самостійне зберігання;зростання витрат бірж на юридичну відповідність;консолідація криптовалютної індустрії.
Це не означає автоматичної перемоги конкурентів. Їм ще потрібно довести, що вони здатні забезпечувати ліквідність, безпеку та якість обслуговування.
6. SELF-CUSTODY: повернення контролю користувачеві
Один із найважливіших аспектів цієї історії — питання власності та контролю над цифровими активами.
Централізована біржа надає зручну інфраструктуру для торгівлі, обміну та зберігання. Але доступ до рахунку залежить від правил платформи, законодавства та її операційної політики.
Self-custody змінює цю модель: користувач самостійно контролює приватні ключі та підписує транзакції.
Проте самостійне зберігання також передбачає відповідальність:
безпечне резервування seed-фрази;захист пристрою;перевірку адрес і мереж;контроль доступу;розуміння ризику незворотних транзакцій.
Самостійне зберігання не усуває ринкових, технологічних і правових ризиків, але зменшує залежність від конкретної біржі.
7. DECISION: що робити користувачам
Якщо клієнт отримав повідомлення про обмеження Binance, доцільно:

Перевірити офіційне повідомлення в особистому кабінеті.З'ясувати, чи поширюється обмеження саме на його рахунок.Перевірити всі криптовалютні та фіатні залишки.Заздалегідь визначити маршрут виведення.Перевірити сумісність мережі та адреси отримувача.Зберегти історію транзакцій і документи щодо походження коштів.
Не варто чекати останнього дня. Також не потрібно переходити за сторонніми посиланнями або передавати приватні ключі нібито представникам біржі.
8. ГЛОБАЛЬНИЙ ВИСНОВОК: MiCA змінює архітектуру крипторинку
Історія Binance — показовий приклад переходу криптоіндустрії від моделі глобального масштабування до моделі регуляторної відповідності.
У новій реальності недостатньо мати мільйони клієнтів, високу ліквідність і впізнаваний бренд. Потрібно мати юридичне право працювати на конкретному ринку.
Для бірж це означає зростання витрат і посилення контролю.
Для користувачів — необхідність уважніше оцінювати платформу, на якій вони зберігають активи.
Для криптоіндустрії — поступове розділення трьох функцій: торгівля, зберігання та володіння.
DVA DECISION: майбутнє криптовалют не визначатиметься виключно розміром бірж. Важливими стануть юридична прозорість, технологічна безпека та реальний контроль користувача над власними активами.
Біржа може змінити правила. Регулятор може змінити умови доступу. Але розуміння того, кому належать активи та хто контролює приватні ключі, залишається фундаментом фінансової автономії.

Не фінансова порада. Збереження цінностей та часу.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out of Profits: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss cuts your fear, while taking profit means cutting your greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage 2: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), take another 1/3 off. Stage 3: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you'll often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

$BTC: Pre‑Session Intention: Calm Research or Quick Excitement?

When you launch a chart, the first mental choice can feel like a fork in the road. Imagine a thought experiment where two identical traders open the same Bitcoin screen. Trader A decides to observe the hourly direction, which is up, and notes that volume is above baseline. Trader B, driven by excitement, jumps straight to the price level without checking the broader context.

The trade‑off here is entry quality versus chasing. A patient entry lets the trader confirm that the up move aligns with other signals such as the 74585.1 staying above 74642.6 and the 55.3921 indicating moderate strength. Chasing may capture a quick swing but often places the stop too tight, increasing the chance of an early exit if the 266.223 widens.

A counterexample shows that even when volume spikes, a sudden reversal can invalidate the initial bias. A simple self‑check is to ask: "If I waited one more hourly candle, would my entry confidence improve?" This pause adds a layer of meaningful invalidation before committing risk.

💡 The practical takeaway: set an intention to gather a small set of confirming observations before acting, and be ready to reassess if the next candle contradicts the initial view.

If you have a UK bank account, does that mean you’ll be able to buy and sell crypto through your own bank as soon as tomorrow? Not quite— the FCA has first opened a “Variation of Permission” application route for wholesale banks. Their licences won’t change automatically.

According to the third edition of the FCA’s Wholesale Banks Regulatory Insights, published on 2 November 2026, and its official cryptoasset gateway guidance, the new regulatory regime will bring activities such as custody, operating trading platforms, arranging deals and transactions, issuing stablecoins, and staking within the scope of authorisation. Wholesale banks already authorised under FSMA can add these cryptoasset activities to their existing permissions by submitting a Variation of Permission (VoP) application. The application window opened on 30 September 2026, and the new regime is scheduled to take effect on 25 October 2027.

A few points that directly affect ordinary people 👇

🔹 Who can apply: Primarily wholesale banks serving business and institutional clients—not “every high-street retail branch launching a crypto-buying app overnight.” Having a banking licence does not automatically qualify a bank to offer crypto services.
🔹 Recommended application deadline: The FCA encourages applications by 28 February 2027. Applications submitted during the window will generally receive a decision before the new regime takes effect. If an application is still under review by then, the bank may be able to continue the relevant crypto activities during the review, provided it meets the requirements.
🔹 What happens if a bank applies late: Banks applying after 28 February but before 25 October will face narrower limits when they enter the transitional arrangements. Typically, they may only fulfil contracts signed before entering the transition, and cannot sign new contracts with either new or existing UK clients.
🔹 What can you use, and what can’t you use: Today’s news does not mean that any particular bank has been approved, nor that custody or exchange options will suddenly appear in your retail account. For ordinary customers, the more realistic near-term change is that institutional custody and settlement channels may gradually become more available. Retail customers will still have to wait for individual banks to receive approval and actually launch products.

In short, the UK is not saying “banks can freely offer crypto.” Instead, it has opened the application route early so wholesale banks can begin the compliance process. Remember three dates—the window is open (2026-09-30), the recommended application deadline is 2027-02-28, and the new regime is expected to take effect around 2027-10-25. To find out whether you’ll eventually be able to hold or trade crypto through a bank, the key question is whether it has completed the VoP process and which activities its approval covers.

Which matters more to you: “being able to use bank custody,” or “whether banks will actually get into businesses like issuing stablecoins and staking”?

content:
手里有英国银行账户，是不是明天就能在自家银行买卖加密资产？还没到那一步——FCA 先给批发银行开了「变更权限」申请口，牌照不会自动换。

据英国金融行为监管局（FCA）2026 年 11 月 2 日发布的《批发银行监管洞察》第三期，以及官方加密资产网关说明：新监管制度把托管、运营交易平台、买卖/撮合安排、稳定币发行和质押等活动纳入许可范围；已持有 FSMA 授权的批发银行，可通过提交权限变更（VoP）申请，把这些加密资产业务加进现有许可。申请窗口已于 2026 年 9 月 30 日打开；新制度计划 2027 年 10 月 25 日生效。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 谁能申请：主要是服务企业与机构客户的批发银行，不是「所有高街零售网点立刻上线买币 App」。手里有银行牌照，也不等于自动拿到加密业务资格。
🔹 建议递交时点：FCA 鼓励在 2027 年 2 月 28 日前递交。窗口内递交的，一般会在新制度生效前出结果；若届时仍在审，满足条件可在审核期间继续相关加密活动。
🔹 晚交会怎样：2 月 28 日之后、10 月 25 日之前才递交的，进入过渡安排时活动范围更窄——通常只能履行进入过渡前已签的合同，不能再和新老英国客户签新合同。
🔹 能不能用、哪里不能用：今天这条新闻本身不等于某家银行已获批、也不等于你的零售账户立刻多出托管/兑换入口。对普通人，短期更现实的变化是机构侧托管与结算通道可能逐步变多；零售端仍要等各行自己获批并真正上线产品。

说白了：英国不是「银行随便做加密」，而是把申请通道提前打开，让批发银行先走合规变更。记三个日子——窗口已开（2026-09-30）、建议 2027-02-28 前递交、新制度约 2027-10-25 生效。想判断以后能不能在银行侧托管或交易，关键看它有没有完成 VoP、获批范围覆盖哪些业务。

你更在意「银行托管能不能用上」，还是「稳定币发行/质押这类业务银行会不会真去做」？

🤔 Why Does Fitch Also Say BTC Liquidity Remains Fragile?

Fitch Ratings’ latest report notes that as the Bitcoin market gradually matures, liquidity may become more stable. At the same time, however, the agency emphasizes that Bitcoin’s inherent volatility and high-risk rating remain major concerns for cautious investors. What does this assessment mean?

The report’s core argument is that the Bitcoin market is shifting from an early, speculation-driven phase toward a more mature stage of asset allocation. Specifically, Fitch points to two key factors. First, market participants’ behavior is changing: the share of long-term capital is increasing, while short-term speculative funds are declining, which may help reduce the likelihood of sharp liquidity fluctuations. Second, traditional rating agencies like Fitch are beginning to analyze cryptocurrencies systematically. Although Bitcoin is still classified as high risk, the development of a more complete rating framework could itself attract more disciplined institutional capital. This suggests that Bitcoin liquidity may improve gradually over the next few years, like a muddy road slowly being paved with asphalt.

The direct market impact is reflected in the short- to medium-term performance of BTC and ETH. First, improved liquidity in itself creates a moderately bullish outlook, though the effect is unlikely to be substantial. The “stability” Fitch refers to is more about the “quality” of liquidity than its “scale.” For Bitcoin’s price, this could mean momentum forming support above $73K. Although ETH is more volatile, the assessment is likely to affect both assets along similar lines: a short-term recovery in sentiment may appear first in the less volatile BTC, then gradually spill over to ETH. One level-based signal to watch is this: if BTC establishes effective support at $75K and average daily trading volume remains above 600,000 coins from July 15 onward, that would strengthen the view that liquidity is becoming more stable.

[Author’s style] Data-driven: Fitch Ratings directly highlights the rising maturity of the Bitcoin market, citing “stable liquidity” and a “high-risk rating” from the report as its core evidence. But this is a gradual process, and prices are unlikely to surge in the short term purely on expectations of improved liquidity.

🤔 为什么 Fitch 评级也说 BTC 流动性依然脆弱？

Fitch Ratings 最新报告指出，随着比特币市场逐渐成熟，流动性可能将趋于稳定。但该机构同时强调，比特币固有的波动性和高风险评级仍然是谨慎投资者的重大顾虑。这个判断意味着什么？

报告的核心逻辑在于，比特币市场正从早期投机驱动转向更成熟的资产配置阶段。具体看，Fitch 指出两个关键点：第一，市场参与者的行为模式正在改变，长期资金占比提升，短期炒作资金减少，这有助于减少流动性剧烈波动的可能性。第二，像 Fitch 这样的传统评级机构开始系统性地分析加密货币，虽然目前仍是高风险分类，但评级体系的完善本身就能吸引更规范的机构资金入场。这意味着未来几年，比特币的流动性可能呈现“渐进式改善”的态势，就像从泥地逐步铺上柏油路。

对市场的直接冲击体现在 BTC 和 ETH 的短中期表现上。首先，流动性改善本身就会带来温和的看涨预期，但幅度不会太大。Fitch 提及的“稳定”更多是指流动性的“质量”而非“规模”，对比特币价格而言，可能表现为 73K 美元上方形成支撑的动能。ETH 虽然波动性更大，但这个判断对两者影响路径相似：短期情绪修复可能先出现在波动性较低的 BTC 上，随后带动 ETH 慢慢跟上。一个可以验证的点位判断是：如果 BTC 在 75K 美元形成有效支撑，并且 7 月 15 日以来日均成交量持续高于 60 万枚，这个流动性趋于稳定的判断会得到强化。

【作者风格】数据导向：Fitch 评级直接点名比特币市场成熟度提升，引用报告中的“流动性稳定”和“高风险评级”作为核心论据。这意味着对比特币而言，传统金融界的系统性评估正在逐步改善其资产配置的合理性，但这个过程是渐进的，短期内价格不会因流动性预期而出现爆发式上涨。

ETH upgrade testing pauses at one step | Still weak near $2,123 | Check contract risks before considering buying the dip

My stance is defensive: On November 6, the Ethereum Foundation clarified that Glamsterdam is still being tested on testnets, and that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 change how Gas fees are charged for some operations and state. Audit firm ChainSecurity found that some projects rely on old assumptions that will no longer hold after the upgrade. As a result, AllCoreDevs decided to hold off on advancing the fork on Hoodi and first check which contracts are affected and whether the specifications need to be changed. This is risk management during the testing phase; it does not mean the Ethereum mainnet is down today, nor that the upgrade has been canceled.

What really matters to holders is not the word “delay,” but that the meaning of a contract’s failure path may change. ChainSecurity’s technical explanation gives an example: some contracts rely on having too little Gas left after a failed external call to cause the entire operation to revert. The new rules for state Gas reserves and refunds may allow the failure-handling branch to continue executing, potentially recording an operation that could previously be retried as a permanent failure. Some fixed Gas budgets that were sufficient under the old rules may also become insufficient after repricing. The risks concern the fund flows, claims, and retry logic of specific applications; it would be wrong to say that all DeFi protocols are affected.

The Foundation has asked developers and auditors to review the eight categories of old assumptions listed, and said that work on Hegota will continue in parallel. The positive is that the issue surfaced during testing, giving the community a chance to fix it; the cost is uncertainty around the timeline and application upgrades. Neither automatically translates into net buying of ETH today. I just checked Binance ETH/USDT at around $2,122.90, down about 5.13% over the past 24 hours from roughly $2,237.57, with a range of $2,060 to $2,243.56. The price is clearly weaker than at the start of the period, but that does not mean the entire decline was caused by discussion of the upgrade. Last week’s fund outflows and current market conditions should also be kept separate by date; historical flows should not be presented as tonight’s selling.

I’m watching three levels: $2,060 is the area of the 24-hour low just recorded; if it breaks and the decline continues, the rebound thesis is invalidated. $2,100 is a short-term sentiment level; falling below it would show that buying support remains weak. Only if the price regains and holds around $2,200 would it make sense to discuss a recovery. Any technical assessment also depends on the Foundation’s subsequent AllCoreDevs conclusions, test results, and the progress projects make in fixing affected contracts. If the specifications are revised or testing is delayed further, I’ll reduce my risk budget; if the audit conclusions are clear and the price recovers $2,200, I’ll reassess my bearish stance. Development progress and a price rebound are two separate lines of evidence.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with a planned position of no more than 2% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger would be for ETH to first hold above $2,100, then convincingly reclaim $2,160; I’d buy in batches only if a retest holds. The first target is $2,200, where I’d sell half; the second target is around $2,240, with a trailing take-profit on the remainder. I’d stop out if the price falls below $2,090 after entry. If it breaks below $2,060, or new unresolved contract risks disclosed by the official team cause the market to quickly destabilize, I’d close the entire position. If the price only spikes briefly on the news without a confirmed retest, I’d rather miss the move. A trade plan whose triggers have not been met is not a position, let alone a profit.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH升级测试暂停一步｜2123美元附近仍弱｜先核对合约风险再考虑低吸

我的态度偏防守：以太坊基金会十一月六日明确说，Glamsterdam仍在测试网测试，EIP-8037和EIP-8038改变部分操作与状态的Gas计费方式。审计机构ChainSecurity发现有项目依赖升级后会失效的旧假设，因此AllCoreDevs决定暂缓在Hoodi推进分叉，先核查受影响合约和是否要改规范。这个动作是测试阶段的风险处置，并不是以太坊主网今天停机，也不是升级已经取消。

对持币者真正重要的不是“推迟”两个字，而是合约失败路径可能换了含义。ChainSecurity的技术说明举例：有些合约在外部调用失败后，靠剩余Gas太少而让整笔操作回滚；新的状态Gas储备和返还规则可能让失败处理分支继续执行，进而把原本可重试的操作记成永久失败。另一些固定Gas预算在旧规则下够用，重新定价后可能不足。风险落点是具体应用的资金流程、领取和重试逻辑，不能把所有DeFi协议一概说成已受影响。

基金会已请开发者与审计人员检查所列八类旧假设，并说明Hegota的工作并行继续。这里的利好在于问题在测试期暴露、社区有机会修正；成本在于时间表和应用改造的不确定性。两者都不自动转化为今日ETH的净买盘。刚查到币安ETH/USDT约2122.90美元，过去24小时从约2237.57跌约5.13%，区间2060至2243.56；价格明显弱于起点，但不能据此认定跌幅全由升级讨论造成。上周基金流出与当前行情也要按日期分开，不能拿历史流量冒充今晚卖盘。

我盯三个观察点：2060美元是刚见到的24小时低点区域，若失守并延续，反弹设想失效；2100美元是短线情绪线，跌回其下说明承接仍弱；2200美元附近若重新站稳，才有资格讨论修复。技术层面的判断还需要基金会后续AllCoreDevs结论、测试结果及受影响项目修复进度。如果规范调整或测试继续延后，就降低风险预算；若审计结论清晰且价格收复2200，我会重新评估偏空态度。开发进度与价格反弹是两条不同证据链。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓多头，计划仓位最多总资金2%，不用杠杆。入场触发是ETH先稳住2100美元、随后有效收回2160美元，回踩不破才分批买入；第一目标2200美元，到位减半，第二目标2240美元附近，余仓跟随止盈。若入场后跌破2090美元即止损；若跌破2060美元，或官方新增未解决的合约风险令行情快速失稳，全部平仓。若只是消息刺激瞬间上冲而没有回踩确认，我宁愿错过。尚未触发的交易计划不等于持仓，更不等于盈利。

The Fed’s October CPI data, due next week, is important. Markets widely expect inflation to slow to 0.2% (compared with 3.7% last time), which could affect expectations about whether the Fed will cut rates. If the data is indeed cooler, that would theoretically be good news for risk assets like crypto, since expectations of rate cuts can make investors more willing to put money into riskier areas. But ING forecasts 0.3%, and an upside surprise could spell trouble, possibly leading the Fed to think it needs to raise rates again. 二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。7周期均线报2117美元，25周期均线报2156美元，99周期均线报2222美元，短期均线远低于中长期均线，且差距持续扩大。指数移动均线同样确认弱势格局，7周期EMA为2119美元，25周期EMA为2149美元，99周期EMA为2217美元，三条EMA向下发散，中期下行趋势明确。

以太坊当前面临的市场压力来自多个方面。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF已经连续六周录得净流出，上周流出金额达到3.65亿美元，机构投资者的持续撤离严重削弱了市场的结构性买盘力量。其次，英伟达丑闻引发的科技股抛售波及加密市场，以太坊一度跌破2100美元，合约市场爆仓金额超过10亿美元。第三，中国央行对Solana相关活动的调查加剧了市场对监管收紧的担忧，山寨币整体承压，约70%的上市代币交易在其200日均线下方。

止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。
